title: Santa Monica Premium Electric Mountain Bike Tour
includes: 2025 Specialized Kenevo Expert Electric Mountain Bike
Full Premium mountain bike gear, helmet, and eyewear
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
Dress code: comforatble shoes for biking (no flip-flops or sandals)
All passengers must be 5'0 (152 cm) or taller to ride the eBike
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
All guests must be comfortable with riding a bicycle
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us on this unique electric mountain biking experience that winds its way through the forest of beautiful sycamore trees and crosses running water that is usually present in the spring time. You’ll be able to explore the beautiful Santa Monica mountains on the most premium mountain bikes available on the market (Ducati,Husqvarna,Specialized). 

 Riders of all levels welcome (no experience is necessary).You’ll come across views of the blue Paciifc Ocean as well as endless Mountain ranges on the way to our destination, the Nike Missile Control site. We'll make a stop to check out the iconic Nike Missle Base which was constructed during the Cold War. This adventure will give you an insider expericence of what it feels to ride amongst locals. This trail system is one the favorites among locals here in Santa Monica.
